Mission: Fast-entry precision strikes aimed at capturing micro-profits (+1 → +10 USD) while maintaining ultra-low exposure time.

Privates.Role: Quick-lock scalps, rapid entry and exit to secure micro gains (+1 → +2 USD).

Specialists.Role: Mid-risk scalps targeting +3 → +5 USD; tighten trail after profit trigger.

Major.Role: Session overseer; reinforces during minor drawdown, locks +10 USD target.

Joker_Sniper.Role: Recovery trigger at −150 USD; executes double-or-nothing rescue strike.

Operational_Rules.Exit_Condition: On volatility spike or target hit

Doctrine_Summary: Privates secure micro profits, Specialists extend range, Major guards the drawdown, and Joker Sniper restores balance. The Assassins strike fast, retreat early, and preserve capital for the next mission.
